Our two most popular options are the Hybrid Mattress and the Hybrid Premium Mattress. Here is how they compare to help you decide which is better for you:

Hybrid Mattress (Best Value for Money)

Thickness: 25 cm (7 comfort layers)
Feel: Medium-firm
Best for: This is our standard, highly reliable choice. It offers excellent support and is perfect if you are looking for a high-quality mattress that fits a sensible budget while providing a balanced, daily comfort.

Hybrid Premium Mattress (Enhanced Comfort)

Thickness: 27 cm (8 comfort layers)
Feel: Balanced
Best for: This model features thicker foam layers (10 cm vs 7 cm). It provides a more "premium" and plush feel with a more progressive welcome. It is the best choice if you are willing to invest a little more for additional comfort and a more enveloping sensation.

Both models feature our advanced support technology and are manufactured in France to ensure durability and quality.

Based on your preference for everyday use and value for money, the Hybrid Mattress is a fantastic and very sensible option. However, if you prefer a slightly softer, more luxurious welcome, the Hybrid Premium might be worth the upgrade.
